allow: PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 4; try { Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:8000/search/health" } catch { Write-Host "Not up yet: $_" })
PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8000/search/health" -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "Status: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Host $r.Content } catch { Write-Host "Error: $_" })
